<function=python>
<parameter=code>

# pass 2 steps with safe LEFT moves, then check for new greens
res=action(['LEFT','LEFT'])
def ngreen(f): return sum(1 for n in f.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='N')
def player(f):
    pts=[]
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('b','Y'):
            for p in n['boundary']: pts.append(p)
    return (min(p[0] for p in pts),max(p[1] for p in pts)) if pts else None
print("step", current_frame.step, "ngreen", ngreen(current_frame), "player", player(current_frame),
